preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2000 for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the required string n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of a substring a is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= min(26, a) for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the required number of distinct letters b in each substring of length a is between 1 and min(26, a) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, a, b in test_cases) <= 2000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for s, (n, a, b) in zip(output_strings, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output string s has the length n specified in the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(set(s[l:l+a])) == b for l in range(n - a + 1)) for s, (n, a, b) in zip(output_strings, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, each substring of length a in the output string s has exactly b distinct letters.
